newsitem.title: FRANCE: More cargo goes from Paris to to Katmandu.
newsitem.headline: More cargo goes from Paris to to Katmandu.

text.p: Globe Air Cargo, French cargo sales agent for Royal Nepal Airlines, said the airline was planning to change the type of aircraft on its weekly passenger service between Paris/Orly and Katmandu, a move which would increase cargo capacity on the route.

"Royal Nepal currently operates a Boeing 757 between Paris and Katmandu which only offers an average cargo capacity per flight of two tonnes. However, we are hoping the airline will be operating an Airbus 310 during the forthcoming tourist season in Nepal, which can offer eight to ten tonnes space for palletised freight per flight," a Globe Air Cargo official told Reuters.
